source_system: The ONLY source-modeled cognitive candidate is a feature-tuned V1 population with iso-feature interactions, local maximum-response salience assignment and assumed monotone response-to-exogenous-RT relation under conditional scene. No fitted recurrent full attentional controller/neural implementation reported.
world: Stimulus bar configurations, feature-singleton category, physical V1 anatomical uncertainty, other cortical areas, motor readout when outside source-specified cognitive mechanism, experimenter-set fixed search objective.
experiment: Original earlier eight-person heterogeneous button-press RT sample with six CMO-eligible observers, 30x22 bars, pseudorandom near-periphery singleton positions, histogram/discrepancy analysis; only observational behavioral validation of specified conditional race identity.

C1_append_only_precision.append_only: Condition Eq30 on paper's approximate independent neural response fluctuations across selected cell classes, approximate independence singleton/background responses and irrelevant-feature distribution invariance. Does not measure actual V1 noise.

C1_append_only_precision.source: original pp18–23 Table1 Fig10; Methods Eqs40–45
C1_append_only_precision.append_only: 'No free parameters' applies source-predicted distribution conditional on six measured RT input populations and Eq30 race model; histogram bins, distance metric, stochastic distribution estimation and optimized constrained solve remain analysis hyperparameters and observed inputs.

Predicted vs observed six-human nonrejection p>.05 is limited behavioral consistency given source statistical power, not identification of full neuronal generative architecture, or proof of zero extrastriate contribution.

Original Eq30 is an equality in distributions of MIN races of stochastic RT variables, conditional on original response distributions and f(max); not pathwise identical times on repeated individual trials.
